title: Velo Crispy Peppermint Slim Nicotine Pouches
description: Velo Slim Crispy Peppermint Nicotine Pouches offer a clean Peppermint flavour rounded off with a crisp cooling note, producing a taste that is bright, simple and refreshing. This straightforward profile makes Crispy Peppermint a popular option for users who enjoy a classic mint pouch. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is delivered steadily without smoke, vapour or odour, providing a practical alternative to other nicotine products. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide variety of flavours and strengths. Crispy Peppermint comes in two options: Mild 6mg for those who prefer a lighter nicotine dose, and Medium 10mg for a more potent release. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
